question: Is direction D001 already explored or contradicted: Change the temporal component from a monotone elapsed-time decay to a validity-interval-aware, retrieval-agnostic re-ranking term, and make the leakage-controlled evaluation protocol and a clause-level versioned benchmark part of the contribution rather than only the evaluation. Concretely: score(q,p) = s(q,p) + lambda * g(t_q, interval(p)) where g is governed by the version's in-force interval, with hard in-force filtering, monotone decay and a content-blind date-only ranker as baselines, lambda tuned on a held-out split, and version-selection accuracy@k reported per query-date regime across BM25 and dense retrievers.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
